active.description: Measured (HEAD c9100eaee): ADRs are proposed at any phase - `specs/ADRs/AGENTS.md:16` "Any agent may append a record with status proposed"; `dd-gitflow-default/SKILL.md:56` + `scripts/_worktree_kinds.py:20` (the backlog kind allows `decisions.jsonl`); mid-session offers in `dd-domain-modeling/SKILL.md:48-57`, `dd-architecture-survey/SKILL.md:77`, `dd-manager-orchestration/SKILL.md:35`, `dd-release-implementation/MEMORY-UPDATE.md:23`; `dd-grill-me/SKILL.md:43` (step 14) turns every decision into an ADR line; `dd-release-definition` has no ADR step; 0171-0175 were proposed at backlog intake (807116479). 0/175 records carry alternatives; schema `additionalProperties:false` (decision-record-v1 :7,86), no options field; `ruling.words` allows a "grill answer id" (`scaffold/ADRs/AGENTS.md:18`, schema :91); 147 accepted between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-03. Change: an ADR is born only in `dd-release-definition`, after the picked backlogs are read together and before the SPEC, through dd-ask-me `references/adr.md`. Threshold, all three: one-way door (reversal costs more than this release or touches a published contract/data); >=1 architecturally-significant criterion (structural/cross-cutting, interface/contract, dependency, quality-attribute target, first of its kind, past troublemaker in the bug ledger); >=2 genuine options - else a one-line SPEC statement. Remove `decisions.jsonl` from the backlog kind's allowed set and its gitflow §3a row; every mid-session ADR offer becomes "goes to the release's ADR session". Done when: a backlog worktree cannot commit `decisions.jsonl`; a new record without options is refused; dd-release-definition carries the ADR step. Relates: dd-ask-me-owned-questioning-skill.
